facts.anchor: Busy? Meg texted on Sunday. Feel like a visitor?
facts.fact: Zak 的周日日程：剪草、洗车（父亲看 mower/buckets 就知道是星期天、不会问要不要去店）。

facts.anchor: I feel like I’m stranded on an alien planet, I replied. Sure. Drop by
facts.fact: Dale 拿着钳子出门问她「Are you selling cookies?」——又一次错认。

facts.anchor: I was in the front yard when she pulled up twenty minutes later and parked at the edge of the lawn. She brought a six-pack from Tap That and fish tacos from a food truck we both liked.
facts.fact: Dale 仍以为 Debra 退休了、要打电话问候她。

facts.anchor: “I was hungry,” she explained as I popped open a couple of lawn chairs and gave her a brief kiss. “I should have asked if Dale can drink alcohol, though.”
facts.fact: 坏消息双响：母亲基本同意买 condo、Georgia 即将复工——她月底就要走（Eleven days）。

facts.anchor: “I’ll open a beer for him. He doesn’t usually finish it.” It was great to be outside on such a nice day. I’d already mowed the lawn and washed the car. Dad was in the open garage, poking aro
facts.fact: 她的账单式自供：Shelby 自己撑完高三并考进 U of C、还送 Roddie 上学、替 Joel 洗衣服。

facts.anchor: “Hello.” Dad came out with a pair of pliers in his hands. He smiled politely at Meg. “Are you selling cookies? Run get my wallet, Zak.”
facts.fact: 她的核心遗憾：Roddie 不肯说出柜，是因为怕她「担子太重」。

facts.anchor: “This is Meg, Dad. She works in the shop that used to be Debra’s. You’ve met her a few times. Meg brought tacos and beer. You want some?”
facts.fact: Zak 的告白（克制版）：I don't want you to leave now or ever. Especially not now.

facts.anchor: Dale looked at me with confusion. “Where has Debra gone?”
facts.fact: 他的判词：Nothing is going to change in four years, Meg. Except Dad'll be worse.——下半句没说出口的「And I would still love her」被她的手指打断。
